images.title: A slanted line to the edge
images.purpose: Shows the front and right faces of a 6 cm cube unfolded flat, with the shortest path from the ant to the laddu as one slanted straight line.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. Two equal squares side by side in the centre, one slanted green line and one bent grey path.
images.exact_structure: Two equal squares, each 6 units, side by side sharing one vertical edge, thin dark outlines, white fill; the shared edge is a thin dashed grey line. Small grey word 'front' in the lower left corner of the left square, 'right' in the lower right corner of the right square. Ant: a small dark dot at the centre of the left square (3 units from its left side, 3 units up), labelled 'ant'. Laddu: an amber #E69F00 dot at the middle of the top edge of the right square (3 units right of the shared edge, 6 units up), labelled 'laddu'. A thick green #009E73 straight line from the ant to the laddu, labelled 'about 6.71 cm'. A dashed grey path from the ant straight up 3 units to the top edge, then straight right 6 units to the laddu; its up part labelled '3 cm' and its across part labelled '6 cm', forming a right triangle with the green line. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: On the net the shortest path is the slanted straight line, √45 or about 6.71 cm, not 3 + 6 = 9 cm.
images.description: Shows the front and right faces of a 6 cm cube unfolded flat, with the shortest path from the ant to the laddu as one slanted straight line.
images.context: Concept T9.C1x; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Across 3 + 3 = 6, up 3; √(36 + 9) = √45 ≈ 6.708 cm; bent route 9 cm.

image_decisions.why: The concept is a slanted line on a net; the picture shows the line and the right triangle that measures it.
